description: This file defines an interface 'AuthenticationResult' which represents the outcome of an authentication process within a security module. It includes methods to check success, retrieve authorization context, headers, and failure reason.

classes.name: AuthenticationResult
classes.description: An interface representing the result of an authentication process, including success status, authorization context, headers, and failure reason.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Returns true if authentication was successful; false otherwise.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context if authentication succeeded; throws RuntimeException if called when authentication failed.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with this authentication result.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailure
methods.description: Returns the Throwable explaining why authentication failed; throws IllegalStateException if called when authentication succeeded.
